task.title: Integrate experiment registry metadata with MLflow or W&B
task.next: Finalized LP-003: services/registry/experiments now ships a governed MLflow-first registry adapter that mirrors registry lineage, aliases, artifact handoff, and REG-003-compatible promoted_metadata for downstream execution and LP-005 tracking. Verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s services/registry/experiments -p 'test_*.py' (4 tests OK); python3 services/registry/experiments/smoke_test.py (memory backend passed).
task.summary_zh: 把 registry metadata 接到 MLflow 或 W&B，讓實驗結果、artifact 與 promotion 狀態能追蹤。
review_notes_zh: LP-003 通過審查。實現完整：正確的治理語義、完整的 lifecycle state 對應、充分的 lineage 與 rollback 支援、完整的 artifact handoff、promoted_metadata 適於下游使用。所有測試通過。與 LP-005 完全相容。

handoffs.message: LP-003 implementation ready for review: added services/registry/experiments/ with an MLflow-first registry adapter, in-memory + real tracking backends, documented lineage/alias/artifact-handoff rules, and aligned the MLflow pin to 3.10.1. Verified with python3 -m unittest discover -s services/registry/experiments -p 'test_*.py', python3 services/registry/experiments/smoke_test.py, and python3 -m py_compile services/registry/experiments/*.py. Review focus: confirm the experiment_refs/promoted_metadata shape is sufficient for LP-005 and future registry materialization.
LP-003 通過審查: MLflow registry adapter 實現完整，experiment_refs/promoted_metadata 形狀與 REG-001/REG-003/EX-001 相容，可直接支援 LP-005。
